{{Top|leg}}
A '''maghook''' was a small, albeit powerful, cylindrical [[Electromagnet/Legends|electromagnet]] that had the capability of being fused to the end of a cable and used as a [[Grappling hook/Legends|grappling hook]]. The magnet was activated by abrupt jarring, and was deactivated by twisting a small dial.
